{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Wallflower; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Polished vocal pop is less appealing right now than the blues and roots rock in my recent listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: An Acoustic Evening At The Vienna Opera House; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Acoustic blues fits my interests, but I would save this live set for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Goat Rodeo Sessions; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Instrumental string music is not what I am looking for this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Live at the Cellar Door; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A stripped-down singer-songwriter performance appeals, but I am more interested in a blues album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Slipstream; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Bonnie Raitt's blues guitar and roots-oriented songs fit well with my recent Clapton and Boz Scaggs listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Oscd Ad Adele 21; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This appears to be Adele's 21, whose pop focus is not my current preference.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Day In Nashville; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its blues direction sounds relevant, but I would not explore another unfamiliar album this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Down Where the Spirit Meets the Bone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Roots-oriented songwriting interests me, though I would leave this for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: Coming from Reality; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Folk-oriented material is less compelling to me right now than guitar-led blues.
ItemID: NA; Title: In My Soul; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Robert Cray's blues and soul sound is a natural follow-up to Memphis and Old Sock."}
